label: Slack: On File Shared
description: Fires when a file is shared in a channel, optionally filtered to one channel. The event carries the file's id and where it landed, never the bytes; wire Slack: Download File downstream to pull the content.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Needs the files:read scope.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.description: Only fire on files shared in this channel. Leave empty for the whole workspace.

outputs.name: channel
outputs.description: The channel it was shared into.
